prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity north-star desktop web app composition comp, 1536x1024 landscape
Input images: Image 1 is the selected Study Shelf direction reference. Preserve its deep neutral navy field, quiet off-white typography, cobalt focus edge, muted green ready state, restrained academic image tiles, strict rail rhythm, component character, and bilingual density. Do not copy its sidebar, page composition, or exact content thumbnails.
Primary request: Create composition option 2, “Path Rails,” for UniMind’s authenticated bilingual student catalog. The visual world remains The Study Shelf, but the seven-step authorized catalog path becomes the page’s organizing spine.
Composition/framing: no conventional left sidebar. A compact top utility bar holds UniMind, search, language, and profile. Beneath it, five shallow horizontal selection rails stack in sequence for Institution, Program, Academic level, Term, and Cohort; completed selections remain compact and the active Curriculum unit rail becomes much taller. In that active rail, a focused synthetic “Cardiovascular Module” tile expands across roughly one-third of the viewport, revealing Ready state, 12 approved sources, scope, and a dominant “Open workspace” action. Neighboring authorized units slide aside but remain visible. Below, one quiet preview band shows workspace destinations and clear “Coming soon” states. The hierarchy should be understandable without a dashboard card grid.
Text: correctly render “Your study path”, Arabic “مسارك الدراسي”, “Human Medicine”, Arabic “الطب البشري”, “Modules”, Arabic “الوحدات”, “Cardiovascular Module”, Arabic “وحدة الجهاز القلبي الوعائي”, “Ready”, Arabic “جاهز”, “Approved sources (12)”, Arabic “المصادر المعتمدة”, “Open workspace”, Arabic “فتح مساحة الدراسة”.
Interaction implication: keyboard/pointer focus expands one item in its rail; upstream changes visibly clear downstream rails; hidden unauthorized choices are absent; focus and selected states use outline, scale, and labels rather than color alone.
Constraints: Operate-mode product UI; serious academic tone; equal desktop/mobile design logic; accessible contrast; long-label tolerance; synthetic data only; no real institution logos; no invented claims; no browser chrome; no device frame; no watermark.
Avoid: entertainment branding, movie posters, autoplay, generic LMS sidebar dashboard, chatbot-first layout, gamification, glassmorphism, neon glow, gradients, medical organ hero, many equally loud regions.
